name: Lewd Girls, Leave Me Alone! I Just Want to Play Video Games and Watch Anime!: Hentai Edition
storyline: You want to get a girlfriend, but something always stands in your way. The moment you go on a date, you get notifications about the new episode of your favorite anime, or the release of a long-awaited game, or the unannounced stream of a VTuber. You know where your priorities lie so you need to ditch your date as quickly and as painlessly as possible or... give in to the temptation?
summary: You're a REAL GAMER. But are you tough enough to turn down a sexy girl? Dating sims are full of lies, these girls will do anything to keep your date from falling through!
